# R3BOOT | Integrated Recovery Center

> Dadar's integrated recovery and performance clinic. Clinical physiotherapy, contrast therapy (infrared sauna + ice bath), sports massage, clinical Pilates, cupping therapy, and hydrotherapy in Dadar East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400014.

## Core Services

- [Contrast Therapy Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/contrast-therapy-mumbai): Clinically structured infrared sauna and ice bath protocol supervised by physiotherapists. 3:1 hot-to-cold ratio. Dadar, Mumbai.
- [Ice Bath Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/ice-bath-mumbai): Supervised cold immersion for muscle recovery. Physiotherapy-guided protocol.
- [Physiotherapy Dadar](https://www.r3boot.in/physiotherapy-dadar): Clinical physiotherapy by Dr. Hiral Parikh (15+ years) and Dr. Vaishali Rauniyar. Back pain, knee pain, sports injuries, post-surgery rehab.
- [Sports Massage Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/sports-massage-mumbai): Performance-driven sports massage for athletes by certified therapists.
- [Cupping Therapy Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/cupping-therapy-mumbai): Certified cupping therapy for muscle recovery and pain relief.
- [Clinical Pilates Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/clinical-pilates-mumbai): Physiotherapy-led Pilates for rehabilitation and core strengthening.
- [Aqua Therapy Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/aqua-therapy-mumbai): Aqua treadmill rehabilitation for knee pain, arthritis, and post-surgical recovery.

## Condition Pages

- [Aqua Therapy for Knee Pain Mumbai](https://www.r3boot.in/aqua-therapy-for-knee-pain-mumbai): Aqua treadmill treatment for knee osteoarthritis, ACL recovery, and joint pain.

## Practitioners

- [Dr. Hiral Parikh](https://www.r3boot.in/physiotherapy-dadar): Lead Physiotherapist, BPT D.Y. Patil College, 15+ years clinical experience, sports and post-surgical rehabilitation specialist.
- [Dr. Vaishali Vijay Rauniyar](https://www.r3boot.in/physiotherapy-dadar): Physiotherapist, certified in Dry Needling and Aquatic Rehabilitation, sports and orthopedic rehab.
